more_darkness.config.title: More Darkness Settings
more_darkness.config.option.enable_mod.d: Master toggle for all More Darkness effects.
more_darkness.config.option.dark_overwor: Enable enhanced darkness in the Overworld.
Enable enhanced darkness in the Nether.
more_darkness.config.option.dark_end.des: Enable enhanced darkness in The End.
more_darkness.config.option.moon_phase_e: Night brightness varies with the moon phase. Full moon is brighter, new moon is darker.
more_darkness.config.option.minimum_moon: Minimum outdoor brightness at night (starlight, atmospheric glow). Even a new moon won't be pitch black.
more_darkness.config.option.cave_darknes: Ambient light level in caves with no light source. 0 = pitch black (realistic), higher values add faint visibility.
more_darkness.config.option.disable_with: Automatically disable this mod when an Iris/Optifine shader pack is active, as shader packs handle their own lighting.
